owner_decision: Complete the planned GPoint ME-42 automatic V5 release system under OWNER's current full-cycle instruction; authorize only the bounded read-only coalescing transport correction in scripts/prepare_coalescing.py and scripts/test_prepare_coalescing.py, with the existing production baseline and every V5 safety gate. release_infrastructure_risk_contract.risk_description: Bounded one-retry correction of read-only GitHub current-main transport timeouts during GPoint coalescing, with regression tests and exact source proofs. All existing release safety and production gates remain required; no VPN, DNS, routing, proxy, database or MAXIBOT changes.
release_infrastructure_risk_contract.backup_plan: Before pending database changes, the canonical Deploy must create and verify the protected GPoint-only backup, its exact identity, mode, digest and restore/readback evidence; never publish backups or remove existing copies.
release_infrastructure_risk_contract.rollback_plan: Require the current exact production image identities and canonical verified rollback runtime before Apply; preserve current database compatibility and all retained images, and reconcile partial/uncertain Apply by read-only inspection without blind retry.
stop_conditions: Stop before publication or Apply if current main, live production baseline, exact scope or authorization differs.
Stop before Apply if Prepare provenance, GHCR digest/readback, package permission, security, migration, backup, rollback, Worker, lock, health or recovery gate is absent or inconsistent.
Stop without retry on active/conflicting release, ambiguous Apply, changed baseline, failed check, RECOVERY_REQUIRED or uncertain Deployment/API result.
